name: Mr.Invisible -Legend of Rapest-
source:
The enjoyment of sightseeing impossible fear... 
The original situation and setting have now been revived!!

The protagonist, having attained the power to stop time, once hunted down women to appease his own sexual desires.
Now he's handed in that power for the ability to turn invisible.

Starting with all the girls he went to school with, the number of targets is limitless... Go! Go! Go!
Upperclassman - Underclassman - Childhood friends - Female teachers - Female nurses - the Weather Girl etc...

Have a look at the Legend of the Rapist!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE043533.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
观光的享受不可能的恐惧…… 
原来的情况和设定现在已经恢复了！！

主角获得了让时间停止的能力，曾经为了满足自己的性欲而猎杀女性。
现在他已经获得了隐身的能力。

从所有和他一起上学的女孩开始，目标数量无限……去吧！去！去！
高年级生-低年级生-儿时好友-女老师-女护士-天气女孩等等……

快来看看《强奸犯传奇》吧！
